svg.aria-label: Undoing planar prediction is a two-dimensional prefix sum. A 3 by 16 grid of residuals, columns 0 to 7 owned by thread t0 and 8 to 15 by t1. Both threads add up their own eight columns along each row at the same time, a wave prefix sum hands the total of t0 to t1, which adds it to its values, and running sums down the columns turn every cell into its sample.

g.text: each cell stores the residual x - (W + N - NW)
t0 and t1 each add up their own 8 columns, at once
a wave prefix sum hands t0's total to t1
running sums down the columns give the samples

svg.text: each sample is the sum of every residual above and to its left
the wave prefix sum adds what t0 holds to t1
each thread keeps its 8 column sums in registers, row after row
